title: Code of Alabama 1975, Title 25, Chapter 4 - Unemployment Compensation
verified_how: Expanded Title 25 in the register's table of contents, which shows 'Chapter 4 Unemployment Compensation. (s 25-4-1 to s 25-4-154)' with Articles 1-7 (Definitions; Unemployment Compensation Trust Fund; Employment Security Enhancement Funds; Contributions; Benefits; Procedure for Claims for Benefits; Administration; General Provisions). Also loaded s 25-4-1: breadcrumb 'Title 25 Chapter 4 Article 1 Section 25-4-1 Base Period', source credit '(Acts 1939, No. 497, p. 721; Code 1940, T. 26, s 193.)'.
notes: Benefits and claims are in Article 4 (ss 25-4-70 to 25-4-78) and Article 5 (ss 25-4-90 to 25-4-97). Means-tested public assistance sits separately in Title 38 (Public Welfare).
